title: Colorful Grids
source_topic: CodeChef / ACM-ICPC India Regionals, Online Preliminary Round 2016
statement: You are given five N x N grids, where each grid consists of N 2 unit squares. These grids have been placed in the form of a plus sign(+). For example, image below shows the figure for N = 2. Your aim is to count total distinct ways to color all 5*N 2 unit squares with C colors.
